purpose: Make the existing listening and evaluation probability semantics explicit without changing frozen evidence, numeric gates or permitting observed data.

target_contract.correct_response_probability: Probability of a correct forced-choice response; chance is 0.5, not zero.
target_contract.audible_condition_probability: A distinct probability of an audible condition label; not supplied by the existing listening fit.

synthetic_audit.indeterminate_fixture: Set only the audible-nonmaterial group's forced-choice sequence to thirteen correct responses per twenty trials, retaining all source and listener identities and severity values.
synthetic_audit.analytic_witness: At correct-response truth 0.5, predicting 0.5 yields response Brier 0.25 and audible-class Brier 0.25 against a false label; the correct class prediction zero instead yields class Brier zero.
synthetic_audit.legacy_adapter_probe: The existing Boolean schema accepts all-false human labels; no indeterminate truth is invented for those records.

next_scientific_requirements: Choose and freeze the prediction unit and population averaging rule.
Carry human target uncertainty and indeterminate support into evaluation without converting missing evidence into negatives.
Specify matching proper scores, uncertainty intervals and prospective numeric gates for the selected probability target.
Freeze source-to-condition linkage before any per-source oracle calibration; aggregate treatment labels cannot be broadcast to source cases.
Preserve the full original source, human, oracle and transfer requirements before claiming objective completion.
